products.name: AtomLang Evolved SDK
products.summary: An experimental SDK and protocol for compact, structured coordination between AI systems.
products.problem: Natural-language coordination between systems is verbose and ambiguous for machine control flows.
products.audience: Developers and researchers exploring agent coordination and typed machine messages.
products.role: Research direction, protocol design, SDK experimentation, and verification strategy.
decisions: Encoding, decoding, replay, and checkpoint experiments
proof: A Rust-first research workspace, CLI, and experimental tooling were previously reported.
limitations: It is not a standard and has no universal performance claim.
Benchmark results require reproducible public methodology.

products.name: RealBall26
products.summary: A native C++ basketball game prototype exploring physics-driven gameplay, AI opponents, and athlete customization.
products.problem: Create responsive, physical half-court basketball with believable player and ball interaction.
products.audience: Basketball game players and simulation-focused sports fans.
products.role: Game concept, product specification, game-feel requirements, iterative engineering, and system verification.
decisions: Reported foundation: native Windows C++20 / Direct3D11
Reported prototype systems: physics-based ball handling and shooting
Reported AI opponent, animation rig, and customization work
proof: A playable half-court 1v1 prototype and 120 Hz simulation were previously reported.
limitations: No public build or authentic gameplay capture was supplied for this site.
It is not released, not on Steam, and not presented as a live product.
